routes.name: mass-normalized narrow-bump width-limit convergence study
routes.strength: numeric, own construction (resolves route-2 apparent discrepancy)
routes.summary: Two Hann bumps at t0=-a+w,t1=b-w, amplitude ~1/w (fixed total mass), N scaled so w/dx>=80 up to N=1.6e6; as w->0 min eps'' from ht_derivative converges toward route-1 exact values for 3 (a,b) pairs, correct sign in all cases, magnitude within 2% for 2 of 3, third (near-threshold, strongly asymmetric) at ~80% of target magnitude and monotonically closing at the resolution reached.
